privacy.title: Privacy in WhatsDemo
privacy.description: How your journey is stored and shared.
privacy.storageBody: Contact name, verification badge, messages, simulated attachments, Flows and automatic answers are stored in this browser using localStorage. Interface language and playback speed are also stored locally.
privacy.sharingBody: Copy a link to share the conversation. Anyone with it can read the conversation. Use sample data.
privacy.deleteBody: Clear the saved data for this page in your browser privacy or storage settings. This removes the local draft, edited copies and preferences. Previously copied links still carry their snapshots.
privacy.connectionsBody: WhatsDemo uses browser storage and runs the simulator locally. The hosting provider may process access logs under its own privacy policy.
